'''Janine L. Brown''' (born 1954) is a scientist specializing in the [[reproductive biology]] of [[endangered species]]. She is the head of the National Zoological Park's Endocrine Research Laboratory at the [[Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute]]. Brown has helped to develop non-invasive techniques for tracking fertility in wild animals.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Janine Brown: Distinguished Graduate in Science, Education, & Technology 2009 {{!}} Animal Sciences {{!}} Washington State University |url=https://ansci.wsu.edu/annual-recognition-program/distinguished-graduate/janine-brown/ |access-date=2025-11-18 |website=ansci.wsu.edu}}</ref> Brown has been called "a world authority on elephant reproductive biology"<ref name=SWS/> and is in charge of the elephant reproduction program at the [[National Zoological Park (United States)]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Elephant Reproduction Project Endocrine Research Laboratory|url=http://nationalzoo.si.edu/SCBI/ReproductiveScience/ElephantBreedRepro/EndocrineLabServices.cfm|website=Smithsonian National Zoological Park / Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute|publisher=Smithsonian Institution|access-date=27 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160727204134/http://nationalzoo.si.edu/SCBI/ReproductiveScience/ElephantBreedRepro/EndocrineLabServices.cfm|archive-date=27 July 2016}}</ref>

==Life==
She received her [[Bachelor of Arts]] in animal sciences from [[North Dakota State University]] in 1976, and her [[Master of Arts]] in 1980 and [[Doctor of Philosophy]] in 1984 in animal sciences from [[Washington State University]].<ref name=SWS>{{cite web|title=Dr. Janine Brown, Reproductive Physiologist (SCBI)|url=https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/hea/sws/brown.html|website=Smithsonian Women Scientists|publisher=Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics|access-date=27 March 2015}}</ref> She was later chosen for the Washington State University Women’s History Alumni Recognition Award in 2002<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Janine Brown: Distinguished Graduate in Science, Education, & Technology 2009 {{!}} Animal Sciences {{!}} Washington State University |url=https://ansci.wsu.edu/annual-recognition-program/distinguished-graduate/janine-brown/ |access-date=2026-05-20 |website=ansci.wsu.edu}}</ref>
